title: Liquid Roar Engine
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A driving FM sub-bass built on a sine core whose fm index and harmonicity roar and twist on separate slow clocks. A pitch envelope snaps each note into place while a ladder filter sweep and wobbling resonance give it a liquid, wobble-bass character that morphs over a 32-cycle arc before repeating.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 [eb1 f1] g0 bb0>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5 3>/5")
    .penv("<12 0 -7 5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .lpf(sine.slow(31).range(220, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(8, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.14)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.06)
    .vib("<5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .shape(0.34)
    .pan(sine.slow(23).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.75))
    .room(0.14).gain(0.9)
)
